implementation_head: Pin the final PR commit before any execution approval

next_phase_proposal.name: one-shot routing and tiny E1 regression, no native artifact

next_phase_proposal.input: tracked three-operation synthetic graph/plan in the named test file; no official case pool

preconditions: Approve the exact script/input/commit and independent new budget; this proposal itself is not approval
Resolve the exact Python launcher and its actual process tree; one logical entry is not a proven OS-process count
Provide reviewed external timeout/memory/cleanup enforcement; this PR does not implement a supervisor
Retain missing dependencies as a preflight failure; do not install or rebuild implicitly
Fail fast, no rerun or refunds after unknown outcomes; preserve all raw failure evidence
next_phase_proposal.success_scope: routing, manifest checks, synthetic bridge marshaling and tiny complete E1 regression only; no Windows native ABI, native arithmetic, complete E1 release or performance acceptance

requires: A separately reviewed artifact/build record pinned to the exact kernel source, adapter, compiler flags, OS/architecture, Python/NumPy, dependency identities and binary SHA-256
Windows replay export and calling convention review, real ABI probe and external crash/timeout policy
A new explicit execution card and budget; no reuse of the old 9-plan/64-candidate or sealed pools

one legal fractional-wait plan: explicit unsupported fallback versus one E0 reference
one full result through inherited E1: typed full-object equality with the valid E0 reference
one invalid plan: official rejection before native load, no success reclassification
